fieldValues.title: Type Inheritance
fieldValues.content: Folded into the concept tree (srs#710, RFC-042 Change B). The normative text for `ext:type-inheritance` now lives in the "Type specialisation" concept and its `identityFieldId` / `FieldAssignmentOverride` mechanisms (`com.semanticops.spec/concept` / `mechanism`), succeeding the retired `ext:type-inheritance` subsection (`meta.derivedFrom` on each successor records the provenance). This record is kept only so `ext:type-inheritance` continues to resolve as an RFC-integration token (`scripts/check-rfc-integration.mjs`); it is not rendered by any document view and carries no independent content of its own. Do not edit this field to add prose — edit the successor mechanisms instead.
